card.name: Punctuation inside label section headings
card.fires_on: Commas, colons and the word 'such' at the end of a section heading or cross-reference list in a drug label, such as 'Carcinogenesis,' before 'Mutagenesis, Impairment of Fertility' or 'WARNINGS,' before 'PRECAUTIONS'.
